headline: Dallas Baptist beats Texas Woman's and Western Washington
dek: The victories have lifted Dallas Baptist to twenty wins and two draws without a loss, scoring 70 goals and conceding ten across all matches. No other Lone Star program has a match left on the schedule, leaving North Georgia as the next opponent for the conference's only unbeaten side.
displaced_by: Dallas Baptist beat Texas Woman's and Western Washington to reach twenty wins
